run:reload: nix develop .#linux-desktop -c bash -c 'cd apps/app && flutter run -d linux'
coverage: cd packages/core && dart test --coverage=coverage && dart run coverage:format_coverage --lcov --in=coverage --out=coverage/lcov.info --report-on=lib
test -z "$(grep '^DA.*,0$' coverage/lcov.info)" || { echo 'FAIL: uncovered lines exist'; grep '^DA.*,0$' coverage/lcov.info; exit 1; }
[ -f ../../apps/app/coverage/lcov.info ] || { echo 'FAIL: apps/app/coverage/lcov.info missing - run devbox run test:app first'; exit 1; }
test -z "$(grep '^DA.*,0$' ../../apps/app/coverage/lcov.info)" || { echo 'FAIL: uncovered lines exist in apps/app'; grep '^DA.*,0$' ../../apps/app/coverage/lcov.info; exit 1; }
